chunks: When Our messengers came to Abraham with good news, they said: 'We are to destroy the people of this city, for its people have been wrongdoers.'
ai.seo_question: Who were the messengers that came to Abraham with good news?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the dual role of divine messengers as bearers of glad tidings and warners, specifically linking the destruction of Sodom to the moral decay of its inhabitants. The narrative highlights how Abraham’s intercession was met with a firm decree, illustrating that divine justice is inevitable when a community persists in oppression despite prophetic warnings.
